diff --git a/packages/svelte/src/compiler/phases/3-transform/client/transform-client.js b/packages/svelte/src/compiler/phases/3-transform/client/transform-client.js
index 940d6a9..7327383 100644
--- a/packages/svelte/src/compiler/phases/3-transform/client/transform-client.js
+++ b/packages/svelte/src/compiler/phases/3-transform/client/transform-client.js
@@ -363,11 +363,14 @@ export function client_component(analysis, options) {
 		...store_setup,
 		...legacy_reactive_declarations,
 		...group_binding_declarations,
-		...state.instance_level_snippets
+		// if the component has top-level await, snippets must stay inside the async body
+		// so they can reference awaited variables
+		...(analysis.instance.has_await ? [] : state.instance_level_snippets)
 	]);
 
 	if (analysis.instance.has_await) {
 		const body = b.block([
+			...state.instance_level_snippets,
 			.../** @type {ESTree.Statement[]} */ (instance.body),
 			b.if(b.call('$.aborted'), b.return()),
 			.../** @type {ESTree.Statement[]} */ (template.body)
